title: Zack Sabre Jr. & TMDK reach the summit
summary: Zack Sabre Jr. finds a new home after Suzuki-gun and turns technical excellence into a sustained championship campaign. His G1 victory lets him choose an earlier world-title challenge.

chapters.title: A new title and a new faction
chapters.result: Sabre becomes the first World TV champion and joins TMDK.
chapters.context: Shane Haste and Mikey Nicholls welcome him into a new team at the start of the next phase of his career.

chapters.title: Sabre wins the G1
chapters.result: Sabre defeats Tsuji to win the tournament.
chapters.context: He chooses to pursue his championship opportunity in October rather than wait until the Tokyo Dome.

chapters.title: Technical mastery becomes world gold
chapters.result: Sabre defeats Naito for the world title.
chapters.context: The accelerated challenge pays off and puts TMDK’s leading heavyweight at the top of New Japan.
